description: Dual-axis time-series chart showing inference throughput (requests/sec) on the left axis and Gaudi utilization (%) on the right axis. Shows correlation: as request volume increases from 500 to 1,200 req/s, Gaudi utilization rises from 20% to 85%. Xeon 6 utilization remains stable at 45-55%.
visual_elements: Request throughput line (blue, left axis, 500-1200 req/s)
demo_context: Shows how intelligent routing keeps Xeon 6 stable while Gaudi absorbs the heavy workload surge.
